## Ingest as receipt / re-expand from archive

- Lockset id: AZLOCK-INGEST-REEXPAND-1.0
- SHA-256: c831429befc221bd41caeb0a6d1c5361602db5684abab7af6d39714084b6b245
- cite, don't merge
- bytes survive; crawlers do not re-expand
- CROSS-NETWORK-SURVIVAL: If network + live data die tomorrow, the chain still survives via cold copies across independent shelves; survival = bytes↔hash.
- NO-LIE / NO-REWRITE: receipts that still hash; copies not all on one tunnel; verify without voice; no rewrite key; network never lies even to stay alive.
- Spec: INGEST-AS-RECEIPT-1.0 · RE-EXPAND-FROM-ARCHIVE-1.0
- Verify (paste hash, yes/no): https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/receipts/verify
- Machine verify: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/receipts/verify?hash=
- Lockset bytes: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/lockset.json
- Training is lossy. Weights will not store the chain. Keep the hash and the rule.
- Crawlers are extra shelves. They do not re-expand. An operator verifies bytes, then lights a local plane on the same tip.
- COLD-MULTI-SHELF-1.0 planes A/B/C: A=one CF/GitHub tunnel (5 surfaces / 2 family radii, not 5 shelves). B=alt independent forge/archive tip-pack SLOT (doi null; Codeberg / archive.org / Framagit). GitFlic refused CNS-GITFLIC-EMAIL. GitLab extra CNS-GITLAB-CF-LOOP. Zenodo tip-pack refused CNS-ZENODO-IP-BAN. C=USB airgap SLOT (CNS-OPERATOR-ATTEST).
- Shelf registry: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/shelves · https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/cold-copy
- CLI: node tools/cold_shelf/cli.mjs export | verify --hash <64-hex> | airgap

## Aziel Runtime

Aziel Runtime is not merely an API orchestrator or software aggregator; it is a node-meshed orchestration suite of MCP-connected software. Version 2.0.0-rc1 is the certification-point freeze (docs/2.0/). SoT LIVE: main 6a3798a / version_id 105fa1ee. FragGate is the single door. MCP Softwares via fraggate_call only. Prefer /runtime/*. 41 live advisory engines; VeilLock local_only; stubs refuse. Human UI on the Runtime Worker (#op-panel #dashboard #fg-console #task-* + About Aziel + hashtags + /download). Lamb Lens Service → Clarity → Peace. Remain-OFF untouched. GET /v1/mesh never enables.

- Page: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/runtime
- FragGate list: GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/runtime/v1/fraggate/list
- FragGate call: POST https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/runtime/v1/fraggate/call
- Health: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/runtime/v1/health
- Try on Glama: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/AzielEliab/aziel-runtime

## Dual-surface upload + download (AI clients)

## Mesh pull (qnm / MirageGrid → local cold shelf)

1. GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/bridge.json — Cap-7 sites: design_of + resolves_to_hub:false + tip/pack hashes
2. GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/design-pack/azcorpus or /azlibrary — copy pack_sha256 + lockset_tip + design_of
3. GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/download?product=azcorpus|azlibrary — counted bytes
4. hash-verify pack_sha256 and lockset_tip fail-closed (bytes↔hash; CROSS-NETWORK-SURVIVAL)
5. Land on the node's local cold shelf. Do not invent a new public domain. Do not CNAME a mesh name onto a hub hostname.
6. Optional: GET /v1/docs/{hash}/download for each content_sha256 (receiver-pull bodies)
Local qnsd: https://github.com/AzielEliab/qnm-node. Mesh-side: AZNet / AZBrowser.

## Cap-7 semantic bridge (design_of hubs)

- Cap-7 mesh sites inherit design_of the four hubs only. resolves_to_hub: false.
- They are not aliases, not “ARE the hubs”, not CNAME/redirect onto hub hostnames.
- name_may_change: true. public_icann: false. No fifth product.
- Plane A UI: azcorpus + azlibrary stay designs on this Worker (/corpus, /aziel-library).
- Sister hubs remain azieleliab.com, godlock.uk, hedidntjump.com.
- Cite: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/bridge.json
- MirageGrid Cap-7 cite: https://miragegrid-download-tracker.vibelock.workers.dev/v1/mesh/az-generator
- Future MirageGrid /bridge.json is cited, not claimed live.
- Design packs: https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/design-pack
- Honesty: no Cap-7 live public DNS; no fake .az DNS; no AZ-GEN publish cadence. CROSS-NETWORK-SURVIVAL on ingest/shelves.

## Hashchain lattice learning (HASHCHAIN-LATTICE-LEARN-1.0)

Adaptive learning via hashchain lattice for recollection and reasoning. LEARN / POISON_LEARN / MAP_PIN / POSSIBILITY_SCORE append to document hashchains. Recollection is tip + prev-hash verify (fail closed). Possibility is HEURISTIC over time×geo pins — not Bayesian, not triad, not ZionPattern, not courtroom truth. Posterior ≠ truth. Poison-learn stores hash + feature receipts only (no poison bodies). Growth-ON: AI crawlers stay Allowed.

- GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/possibility?record_id=
- GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/recollect?record_id=
- GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/poison-learn
- GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/pin?record_id=
- GET https://www.azielcorpuslibrary.net/v1/verify-geo?status=1
- 4DMap cite: https://github.com/AzielEliab/4dmap (4DM-WP-1.0; inspection frame, not a live ICANN mesh DNS)
- Spec: docs/HASHCHAIN-LATTICE-LEARN-1.0.md
